topic: Subletting a Room to a Coworker for the Summer

script.title: SUBLET MY ROOM?
script.scene_zh: 辦公室茶水間 · 談分租
script.story_hook: A spare room meets a searching coworker.
script.intro_zh: 一間空置的房間，剛好遇上正在找房的同事。
script.welcome_en: Hi, pull up a chair by the coffee machine. Today's chat is about subletting a room.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，請先在咖啡機旁坐下來。今天的對話，關於夏天分租一個房間。
script.outro: That's how a room finds a roommate. Listen again and borrow the phrases.
script.outro_zh: 一個房間就這樣找到了新室友。再聽一遍，把好用的說法帶走。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length straight auburn hair tucked behind one ear, small gold hoop earrings, a cream knit cardigan over a floral blouse, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a tall man in his early thirties with a shaved head, a thin goatee, round wire-frame glasses, a heather grey hoodie with the drawstrings pulled tight, and a lean build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, do you have a minute? It's about housing.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ du ju həv ə ˈmɪnɪt ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈhaʊzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你有空嗎？想聊聊住的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I always have time for housing talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ aɪ ˈɔlweɪz hæv taɪm fɚ ˈhaʊzɪŋ tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 當然有，我隨時都願意聊住的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, my family is visiting from July to September.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈfæməli ɪz ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ fɹəm dʒʊˈlaɪ tə sɛpˈtɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是這樣，我家人從七月要到這邊來，整個夏天都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh nice! Are they staying at your place?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs ɑɹ ðeɪ ˈsteɪɪŋ æt jɔɹ ˈpleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 噢，太好了！他們要住你那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are, and my roommate moved out last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑɹ ænd maɪ ˈrumˌmeɪt muvd aʊt læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且我的室友上週已經搬走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, so the second room is just empty now?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm soʊ ðə ˈsɛkənd rum ɪz dʒʌst ˈɛmpti naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，所以第二個房間現在是空的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pretty much, and paying it alone hurts a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti mʌtʃ ænd ˈpeɪɪŋ ɪt əˈloʊn hɚts ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，我一個人扛整份房租，有點吃不消。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, are you thinking about subletting it?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɑɹ ju ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈsʌbˌlɛɾɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你該不會是想分租出去吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Would you ever want a room for summer?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʊd ju ˈɛvɚ wɑnt ə rum fɚ ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！你願不願意整個夏天租我那間空房？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me? Um, honestly, that might solve my problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi ʌm ˈɑnəstli ðæt maɪt səlv maɪ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 我？嗯，老實說，這說不定能解決我的麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean you're looking too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min jʊɹ ˈlʊkɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 你的意思是，你也在找地方？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My lease ends June thirty, and I need a place.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lis ɛndz dʒun ˈθɜɹdi ænd aɪ nid ə pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我的租約六月三十號到期，正愁沒地方去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That timing is almost too perfect, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst tu ˈpɝfɪkt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 這時間點簡直完美得不太真實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, how much would the room cost for summer?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ mʊtʃ wʊd ðə rum kɔst fɚ ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，夏天租下來要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd say six hundred, and utilities split in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd seɪ sɪks ˈhʌndrəd ænd juzˈtɪlətiz splɪt ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 我打算收六百，水電瓦斯費我們對半分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hundred… does that include internet?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈhʌndrəd dʌz ðæt ɪnˈklud ˈɪntɚˌnɛt/
dialogue.zh: 六百塊……這樣包括網路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does, the wifi is weirdly fast, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ðə ˈwaɪˌfaɪ ɪz ˈwɪɹdli fæst ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 包括，老實說那裡 wifi 快得離譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Where does the bus stop for your building?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɛɹ dʌz ðə bʌs stɑp fɚ jɔɹ ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 真好。你們那棟樓的公車站牌在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blocks away, and the train's a ten-minute walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu blɑks əˈweɪ ænd ðə tɹeɪnz ə tɛn ˈmɪnɪt wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 兩個街口遠，走到地鐵站大約十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, tell me about the room itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ðə rum ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 好，跟我說說那間房間本身吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's bright, with a desk and a big closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts bɹaɪt wɪð ə dɛsk ænd ə bɪɡ ˈklɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 光線很足，附一張書桌和一個大衣櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it come furnished or should I bring things?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt kʌm ˈfɝnɪʃt ɔɹ ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 房間附家具嗎？還是我要自己搬東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Furnished, and the couch can stay, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɝnɪʃt ænd ðə kaʊtʃ kən steɪ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 都有附，老實說，那張沙發也可以留給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The couch is the one with the wobbly leg?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kaʊtʃ ɪz ði wʌn wɪð ðə ˈwɑbli lɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你說的是那張腳會晃的沙發嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one, but everyone loves it anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn bʌt ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn lʌvz ɪt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那張，不過每個人都還是喜歡躺上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, sure, cozy beats perfect every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃʊɹ ˈkoʊzi bits ˈpɝfɪkt ˈɛvɹi taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，也是，舒服永遠勝過完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, my cat, Pepper, lives there with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ maɪ kæt ˈpɛpɚ lɪvz ðɛɹ wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 還有，我的貓 Pepper 也住在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, a cat? Um, are you serious right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ə kæt ʌm ɑɹ ju ˈsɪɹiəs ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，貓？嗯，你現在是認真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the best news of my whole workday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə bɛst nuz ʌv maɪ hoʊl ˈwɜkdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真的，這是我今天上班最開心的一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know I'm allergic, right? My eyes, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ aɪm əˈlɜɹdʒɪk ɹaɪt maɪ aɪz ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你知道我對貓毛過敏吧？我的眼睛啊，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I forgot about your eyes, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪ fɚˈɡɑt əˈbaʊt jɔɹ aɪz ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我把你眼睛的事忘了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's okay, but that's a real problem for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts oʊkeɪ bʌt ðæts ə ɹil ˈpɹɑbləm fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 沒事啦，但這對我真的滿頭疼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could Pepper sleep in the living room at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ˈpɛpɚ slip ɪn ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那讓 Pepper 晚上睡在客廳可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that might help, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæt maɪt hɛlp ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這樣說不定真的有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I'd deep-clean everything before you move in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪd dip klin ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ bɪˈfɔɹ ju muv ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 而且你搬進來之前，我會把整間徹底打掃乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds generous. Can I see it this weekend?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈdʒɛnɚəs kən aɪ si ɪt ðɪs ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來真大方。這週末我可以先去看看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, Saturday morning works great for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ wɜks ɡɹeɪt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，星期六早上我很方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One big question: does your landlord allow subletting?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃən dʌz jɔɹ ˈlændˌlɔɹd əˈlaʊ ˈsʌbˌlɛɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一個大問題：你的房東允許分租嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good catch, and no, his lease says no sublets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kætʃ ænd noʊ hɪz lis sɛz noʊ ˈsʌblɪts/
dialogue.zh: 問得好。老實說，他的合約寫著禁止分租。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we'd need his written approval first.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wid nid hɪz ˈrɪtn əˈpɹuvəl fɚst/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們得先拿到房東書面的同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can ask him tonight, he owes me a favor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn æsk hɪm təˈnaɪt hi oʊz mi ə ˈfeɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就去問他，他欠我一個人情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. What if he says no?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wʌt ɪf hi sɛz noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那如果他說不行呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll post it online, and you keep looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl poʊst ɪt ɑnˈlaɪn ænd ju kip ˈlʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就在網路刊登出去，你繼續找你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. Oh, one more thing about the lease.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ oʊ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə lis/
dialogue.zh: 合理。噢，租約還有件事想確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I can take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd aɪ kæn teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你說吧，我撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet hours matter to me, I sleep early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ˈaʊɚz ˈmæɾɚ tə mi aɪ slip ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 我很在意安靜時段，我睡得很早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Totally fine, I'm asleep by eleven anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli faɪn aɪm əˈslip baɪ ɪˈlɛvən ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題，我可是十一點就睡死的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I might win the sleep contest then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ maɪt wɪn ðə slip ˈkɑnˌtɛst ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那睡覺比賽應該是我贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, move-in dates: when would you want to move?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ muv ɪn deɪts wɛn wʊd ju wɑnt tə muv/
dialogue.zh: 那麼搬入日期：你希望什麼時候搬進來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around July first, after my old lease ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd dʒʊˈlaɪ fɚst ˈæftɚ maɪ oʊld lis ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 七月一號前後，等我那邊的租約到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works, I'll clear my boxes out first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜks aɪl klɪr maɪ ˈbɑksɪz aʊt fɚst/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我會先把紙箱清出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your boxes? Um, how many boxes are we talking?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ ˈbɑksɪz ʌm haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑksɪz ɑɹ wi ˈtɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你的紙箱？嗯，你說的大概是幾個紙箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, fifteen, but they're mostly books.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ˌfɪfˈtin bʌt ðɛɹ ˈmoʊstli bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，十五個，不過大部分是書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books are heavy, but I respect a good library.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks ɑɹ ˈhɛvi bʌt aɪ ɹɪˈspɛkt ə ɡʊd ˈlaɪˌbɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 書很重，但我佩服有一個好書牆的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, then? Saturday, ten o'clock, at my place.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ðɛn ˈsætɚˌdeɪ tɛn əˈklɑk æt maɪ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那就說定囉？星期六早上十點，到我家集合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. I'll bring donuts as a housewarming start.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl brɪŋ ˈdonəts æz ə ˈhaʊsˌwɔɹmɪŋ staɹt/
dialogue.zh: 說定。我帶甜甜圈去，當成暖房的第一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're already a great roommate, you know that?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɔlˈrɛdi ə ɡɹeɪt ˈrumˌmeɪt ju noʊ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你已經是個很棒的室友了，你知不知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait till you meet me on laundry day.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tɪl ju mit mi ɑn ˈlɔndɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等你見識到我洗衣服那天再說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send me your address so I can map it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi jɔɹ əˈdɛs soʊ aɪ kæn mæp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 傳你的地址給我，我先把路線查好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. See you Saturday, future roommate.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈfjʊtʃɚ ˈrumˌmeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。星期六見，未來的室友。

script.youtube_title: 【同事變室友🐱】「沙發可以留給你」夏日分租房間全對話🏠☕｜聽完就敢開口談租約｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Subletting a Room for the Summer
script.youtube_title_en: "The Couch Can Stay, Honestly" — Subletting a Room to a Coworker
script.youtube_description:
「那張沙發也可以留給你」——在辦公室茶水間，一場關於夏天分租房間的真實對話是長什麼樣子的？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在咖啡機旁邊的聊天。

你會聽到：開口談住房話題的開場句；報租金、水電對半分、交通時間的細節問法；貓與貓毛過敏怎麼商量；房東允許不允許分租、書面同意該怎麼要；還有搬入日期、安靜時段、紙箱數量的來回確認。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人日常聊天裡的真實語感：um、so、hmm、ha、fair。聽完你就會用：Are you thinking about...、split in half、written approval、What if he says no、See you Saturday。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先記住，腦袋自然就跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The couch can stay, honestly" — what does a real conversation about subletting a room sound like at the office coffee machine? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one spare room and one searching coworker.

You will hear: opening a housing topic politely, quoting rent and splitting utilities, asking about the bus and the train, negotiating around a cat and a cat allergy, checking whether the landlord allows subletting, and confirming move-in dates, quiet hours, and yes, fifteen boxes of books.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the fillers Americans actually use: um, so, hmm, ha, fair. By the end you'll own phrases like Are you thinking about..., split in half, written approval, and What if he says no?

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
夏天要到了，房間空著卻要付兩份租金，你開得了口找同事分租嗎？租金、水電、貓、房東的同意書，到底該怎麼一件件講清楚？

這一集帶大家走進辦公室的茶水間，聽一位住戶把空房分租給正在找房的同事，從開玩笑般的開場，一路聽到成交與約好看房時間，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏠 報租金：I'd say six hundred, and utilities split in half.
🐱 談過敏：You know I'm allergic, right? My eyes, remember?
📝 確認條款：One big question: does your landlord allow subletting?
🍩 敲定見面：Deal. I'll bring donuts as a housewarming start.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這場茶水間的對話走一趟，下次你要談住房的事，話就能自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你也找到一個讓沙發留下來的好室友。
